chunks: The revelation of this Book is from God, the mighty and all-wise.
ai.seo_question: Who revealed the Quran according to Islamic theology?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the Quran's divine provenance, linking its authority directly to Allah's absolute power (Al-Aziz) and perfect wisdom (Al-Hakim). It establishes the text not merely as human composition but as a precise, purposeful revelation intended to guide humanity through divine intellect and might.
